name: Valley of Spears
summary: In western Desolace, the Maraudine guard their stronghold in the Valley of Spears. Beyond the valley lies Maraudon, the sacred burial ground of all centaurkind.

sections.title: Stronghold of the Maraudine
sections.body: The Maraudine hold the Valley of Spears in western Desolace. On foot, you can enter only through narrow mountain passes from the south and east. Rocky chokepoints guard those approaches, while hostile nomad camps fill the way to the clan’s most revered holy site.

sections.title: The Threshold of Maraudon
sections.body: At the valley’s southwestern end, an entrance opens into Maraudon. The sacred cavern holds the tomb of Zaetar, father of the centaur, and Princess Theradras dwells within. The Maraudine defend the canyon fiercely from rival clans and outsiders. Gnome cartographer Melizza Brimbuzzle and scouts who wander in unaware may be captured or slain.

faq.q: Who controls the Valley of Spears?
faq.answer: The Maraudine clan controls the Valley of Spears. It is their chief territory among the centaur factions fighting for dominance in Desolace.

faq.q: Where does the Valley of Spears lead?
aliases: what is at the end of valley of spears
faq.answer: At the valley’s southwestern end, an entrance leads to Maraudon, the holy ancestral cavern and burial ground of the centaur race.

faq.q: How do you enter the valley?
faq.answer: You can enter on foot through narrow mountain defiles to the east and south. Sheer ridges surround the valley.

faq.q: Is anyone trapped in the valley?
faq.answer: Yes. The Maraudine have taken the goblin Melizza Brimbuzzle prisoner and hold her in their camps.

angles.text: As a tauren, you face the ancient enmity between centaur and tauren tribes, which has plagued Kalimdor for generations.
The Alliance watches the region cautiously. The Maraudine have captured exploratory travelers, including the gnome Melizza Brimbuzzle.
